title: Tanh Saturation Rail Escape after Target Shift
intuition: Directly probes Law 4.1 (Functional Realization): Phase 1 trains a tanh generator onto corner (0.9, -0.9) near the saturation rail, then at step 1,001 shifts the target to (0, 0). The optimizer must escape vanishing tanh derivatives within a 400-step deadline and settle with zero saturated samples.
failure_mode: Because tanh'(z) -> 0 near +/-1, standard unconditioned gradients vanish and leave generator outputs permanently trapped at the rail (0.9, -0.9) after the shift.
protocol_notes: Gated by `zero_tanh_smoke`; Four Laws Adherence Law 4 anchor (shift at step 1,001, recovery deadline 400 steps).
